import re
from datetime import datetime


def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (common combined log format):
    <IP> - - [<timestamp>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Example:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Dec/2023:12:34:56 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"

    Returns a dict with keys:
    - ip: str
    - timestamp: datetime
    - method: str
    - url: str
    - protocol: str
    - status: int
    - bytes_sent: int
    - referer: str
    - user_agent: str
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)'          # IP address
        r' - - '                          # separator
        r'\[(\d{2}/\w{3}/\d{4}:\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} [+-]\d{4})\]'  # timestamp
        r' "(\w+)'                        # method
        r' (\S+)'                         # URL
        r' (\w+/\d+\.\d+)"'               # protocol
        r' (\d+)'                         # status code
        r' (\d+)'                         # bytes sent
        r' "([^"]*)"'                     # referer
        r' "([^"]*)"'                     # user agent
